categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in smart community security and smart hospital sectors, focusing on products such as building intercom systems, smart home devices, smart wards, and smart outpatient solutions. It also covers related areas including full air systems, smart access, and smart locks. The business segments integrate digital, networked, cloud-based, and AI technologies to provide comprehensive smart community and hospital solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include AI-driven facial recognition, voice recognition, edge computing, IoT, cloud computing, and 4G/5G communication technologies. The company employs integrated product development (IPD) for R&D, advanced manufacturing with 5G smart factory capabilities, and lean green manufacturing processes. It also develops proprietary AI algorithms, supports multi-protocol smart home solutions (KNX, Zigbee, Bluetooth Mesh, PLC), and embraces the HarmonyOS ecosystem for interoperability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are real estate developers, system integrators, and engineering contractors, primarily serving residential, commercial, hospital, and institutional sectors. The company targets smart communities, smart hospitals, smart hotels, and aging care markets, with a focus on both domestic Chinese and international markets including North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific regions.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in China with expanding international presence. The company is actively developing localized marketing and service teams in key overseas markets such as North America, Europe, Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. It maintains a strong domestic network with offices and sales channels extending into third- and fourth-tier Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of smart security and smart home devices. It manages procurement of key components like IC chips and electronic parts, and maintains strategic supplier partnerships to ensure stable supply and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include innovation-driven development, digital transformation, and global market expansion. R&D focuses on AI large model integration, brainwave interaction technologies for health applications, HarmonyOS ecosystem integration, and smart hospital digitalization. The company invests heavily in AI edge computing, multi-protocol smart home solutions, and smart community security systems, aiming to pioneer new market segments and enhance product competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of building intercoms, smart home devices, smart hospital equipment, and related solutions. The company also earns from service contracts, licensing of intellectual property, and government subsidies. Sales are conducted primarily via direct sales complemented by channel partners, with increasing emphasis on brand-driven and ODM sales internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the building intercom industry, recognized as a key contributor to national and international standards. It ranks top in brand preference for building intercoms and is among the top in smart home product brands in China. It competes with other domestic and international smart security and smart home solution providers, leveraging strong R&D, brand reputation, and comprehensive product ecosystems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 720 million, a decline of 18.58% year-over-year, mainly due to real estate market downturns. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 12.9 million, reflecting a challenging market environment. Despite short-term setbacks, the company increased R&D investment by 15.26% to RMB 79.2 million, maintaining a strong innovation trajectory. It has total assets of about RMB 1.77 billion and equity of RMB 1.27 billion, with ongoing efforts to expand international revenue, which grew 17.08% to RMB 114 million.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes creating safe, comfortable, healthy, and convenient smart community living environments through integrated AI and IoT technologies. Its products feature advanced AI capabilities such as facial and voice recognition, edge computing, and multi-protocol interoperability, enabling seamless integration across smart community, home, and hospital scenarios. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality, and comprehensive service, combined with strategic partnerships (e.g., HarmonyOS ecosystem, Alibaba, Xiaomi), differentiates it as a technology leader with strong brand recognition and a broad, scalable product portfolio.
